item.title: Dalian University of Technology Unveils 20 kg Hydrogen-Powered Unmanned Helicopter
item.description:
A team at Dalian University of Technology's School of Chemical Engineering has developed China's first 20 kg-class hydrogen-powered unmanned helicopter, offering both pure hydrogen fuel cell and hydrogen-lithium hybrid configurations. The 12L fuel-cell variant reaches a 3-hour endurance, several times the roughly 30 minutes of conventional lithium-battery drones, and has completed a sea trial cruise in Force 6 winds.

item.title: Google Open Sources WeatherNext 3 Weather Datasets
item.description:
Google DeepMind has publicly released SatWeave and PARDIG, the two foundational datasets behind its WeatherNext 3 weather model, both hosted on Google Cloud Storage under CC BY 4.0. PARDIG uses a spherical-grid Transformer with ~10 km spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution, outperforming NASA IMERG-Final by over 30% on hourly light-to-moderate precipitation detection and remaining reliable in regions lacking ground radar.

item.title: llama.cpp Adds Arm NEON Kernel for 6.5x Faster Prompt Processing
item.description:
llama.cpp's tiled K-quant matmul previously shipped only AVX-512, AVX2 and AVX inner kernels, forcing Q3_K, Q2_K and IQ-family formats on Arm into a slow path that re-unpacked weights for every dot product. This contribution adds the missing Arm inner kernel built on the NEON SDOT instruction, lifting IQ3_M prompt processing on Neoverse N1 from 11.5 to 74.5 tokens/s (about 6.5x), with 3.3x to 4.9x gains on Neoverse V1 and V2.

原文标题：llama.cpp 新增 Arm NEON 内核 提示处理提速 6.5 倍

Why it matters：为 Arm 服务器补齐低比特量化推理的关键内核，实测提速最高 6.5 倍，直接改善本地与边缘部署体验。

Industry observers report a marked rise over the past six months, mostly without AI disclosure, prompting at least one agency to mandate labeling of AI-altered images.

item.title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen Agentic Model
item.description:
Google released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast agentic model that edges out Gemini 4 Argon on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (51 vs. 50) at a lower price. Its key design is role-splitting: in Google Antigravity, an Orchestrator mode has Gemini 4 Carbon plan while Hydrogen edits files, updates packages and runs tests, handing control back on friction. It scores 57% on Terminal-Bench 4.1 and finishes tasks 2.5x faster, though at $1.50/$7.50 per 1M tokens it costs twice the 3.8 Flash intro rate.

原文标题：Google 发布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 智能体模型

Why it matters：Google 新模型以角色拆分架构切入智能体编码场景，性能与定价数据明确，对开发者选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: Ontology and Memory Help Coding Agents Learn Projects Over Time
item.description:
The article argues that making coding agents truly project-aware requires two complementary mechanisms: an ontology that explicitly encodes domain concepts, relations and validity conditions so models understand team conventions, and recursive self-improvement (RSI) that turns execution feedback into reusable knowledge, with memory handling storage and reuse. The authors ground this in their internal Loop practice, aiming to cut the time agents spend re-learning a project and to stop them repeating mistakes the team has already resolved.

原文标题：本体与记忆让 Coding Agent 越用越懂项目

Why it matters：从知识工程视角系统拆解 Agent 项目记忆问题，本体加 RSI 的框架对构建长期可用的 Coding Agent 有直接参考价值。

item.title: Chinese Academy of Sciences Team Unveils Multi-Scale Lung Nodule Diagnosis Model
item.description:
A research team led by the Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, has proposed M³Net, a hierarchical 3D neural network that mimics radiologists' reading workflow by fusing macro, meso and micro CT image scales for interpretable lung nodule classification. Tested on LIDC-IDRI and USTC-FHLN, it outperformed 12 mainstream algorithms, especially on ambiguous nodules, while using fewer parameters and less compute.

item.title: 玩家用停产傲腾内存跑通 2.8 万亿参数 Kimi K3
item.description:
一名 Reddit 网友在无显卡的家庭实验室环境中，借助已停产的英特尔傲腾持久内存 200 系列与 llama.cpp，成功加载并推理 2.8 万亿参数的月之暗面 Kimi K3 模型。在 1 比特量化下，关闭 DAX 并让热数据走 DRAM 缓存后，输出速度从每秒 0.85 词元提升至 1.5 词元，3 比特量化则仅 0.75 词元，生成 5 万词元需约 18.5 小时。该实验证明超大模型可完全依赖内存层级而非 GPU 显存运行，但速度远不具备实用价值。

Why it matters：以极低成本硬件验证万亿级模型的纯内存推理路径，对关注算力替代方案与本地部署的读者有参考价值。
